readout_other: 32-channel intracortical multi-unit recording; spike time tiling coefficient (STTC) of neuron-pair correlation; peripheral electrical hind-limb stimulation response
direction_notes: Firing in response to peripheral electrical stimulation increased after ultrasound at all five SRFs; pairwise correlation decreased at 10 and 50 Hz SRF and increased at 75, 100 and 125 Hz.

exposures.label: pulsed tFUS at five SRFs (10-125 Hz), S1HL

target.label: somatosensory hind limb (S1HL) region of the rat brain

timing.protocol_description: 500 kHz tone bursts of 200 us at a 3 kHz PRF (burst duty cycle 60%) delivered in blocks at a sonication repetition frequency (SRF) of 10, 50, 75, 100 or 125 Hz (60% duty cycle at the SRF level, total duty cycle 36%) for 5 min, between 30 min before and 60 min after peripheral electrical stimulation every 5 s.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Thirty adult male Wistar rats (weight range 400–600 g) were studied
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: In each animal, two ultrasound sessions and a sham session were performed in a random order before euthanasia.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: Together these generated the fundamental frequency $f _ { 0 }$ of 500 kHz, the pulse repetition frequency (PRF) of 3 kHz, and the SRF of 10–125 Hz
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: Ultrasound was delivered in pulses using a single element focused transducer with a concave surface (AT31529, Blatek Industries, Inc., USA), with an outer diameter of 25.4 mm, a fundamental frequency $f _ { 0 }$ of0.5 MHz, and a nominal focal distance of38 mm.

source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: The tone burst duration was 200 $\mu \mathbf { s } .$ . Ultrasound is delivered with a burst duty cycle of 60%.

source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: Following this, ultrasound stimulation was delivered for 5 min.

flags.reason: Measured by hydrophone behind an excised rat skull in degassed water; text calls it pressure amplitude while the Fig. 1 legend says peak-to-peak. Recorded under in_situ as a through-skull measurement.
Paper says the intensities were 'estimated'; converted from 417 mW/cm2 to W/cm2. Method labelled measurement because the pressure was hydrophone-measured through skull.
Converted from 250 mW/cm2 to W/cm2; described as estimated.
Paper gives burst duty cycle 60%, SRF-level duty cycle 60% and total 36%; the total (36) is recorded.
Nested protocol: 3 kHz PRF of 200 us bursts inside SRF blocks of 10-125 Hz; the 3 kHz PRF is recorded and SRF is in protocol_description.
Each animal had two ultrasound sessions and a sham session (3 sessions in total including sham).
Sham was the collimator moved 3-4 mm laterally still aimed at the anterior skull; three animals also had five baseline sessions without ultrasound.
Source text reads 'of0.5 MHz' (missing space); 500 kHz also stated elsewhere.
